items.title: Morris French Interview
items.q: Luther Denny, he got a music shop on Lee Street.

ctx.x: Luther Denny up there, you know, at least, you see that music shop, every fan.
I didn't miss Buddy Bowler as much, but I didn't ever see him because when I went to Northean to see it went crazy or something, I don't know. Yeah, he died.
